info.title: AlecoAir dehumidifiers (signalk-alecoair)
info.description: Usage API for the WebApp and dashboards, plus the admin-only setup API used by the Plugin Config panel. Local keys are never returned.

200.description: { devices: [{ key, name, connected, power, humidity, profile, model, pathPrefix, lastError }] }

get.summary: State, controls and capabilities of one device

post.description: Only controls the device reports are accepted; DPs the device has not reported are never written.

mode.description: One of the device's modes, e.g. auto | continuous | sleep; external (when external control is allowed) switches external control on, any other mode leaves it

post.description: Switch between the unit's own hygrostat (internal) and control from an external Signal K humidity sensor (external), and set the controller target. Needs External control allowed for the device in Plugin Config. The target is kept by the plugin; the unit is put in its continuous mode and switched on and off.

target.description: Percent or ratio; snapped to the unit's hygrostat step and range (Traditio: 30–80, step 5)

200.description: Device state with control: { configured, available, mode, target, state, reason, sourceHumidity, sourceTemperature, log }

400.description: Rejected (not set up, no sensor path, unit not controllable)
